title: TrustAgent-RFF: Agentic Diagnostic Planning for Reliable RF Fingerprinting under Domain Shift
abstract: arXiv:2610.24930v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Radio frequency fingerprinting (RFF) models can achieve accuracy under source domain conditions but become unreliable when the receiver, distance, collection day, or environment changes. Incorrect predictions in unseen domains may receive high softmax confidence, making confidence thresholding insufficient for trustworthy deployment. We propose TrustAgent-RFF, a prediction level reliability framework for RFF that operates with a frozen in-phase and quadrature (I/Q) classifier without target domain labels. For each device prediction, the framework acquires radio frequency evidence: counterfactual stability, prototype consistency, acquisition domain similarity, and signal quality. A source calibrated trust estimator combines these diagnostics with classifier confidence, prediction margin, and evidence availability indicators. Source derived lower tail penalties and cross module interactions reduce trust when diagnostic signals indicate

translated_title: TrustAgent-RFF：面向域偏移下可靠射频指纹识别的智能体诊断规划框架
translated_abstract: 射频指纹识别（RFF）模型在源域条件下能够取得较高的准确率，但当接收机、距离、采集日期或环境发生变化时，其可靠性会显著下降。在未见域中出现的错误预测可能获得较高的softmax置信度，这使得仅依靠置信度阈值方法不足以实现可信部署。我们提出了TrustAgent-RFF，一个面向RFF的预测级可靠性框架，它可以在冻结的同相正交（I/Q）分类器上运行，且无需目标域标签。对于每次设备预测，该框架都会采集射频证据：反事实稳定性、原型一致性、采集域相似度以及信号质量。一个基于源域校准的信任估计器将这些诊断信息与分类器置信度、预测边际以及证据可用性指标相结合。当诊断信号指示异常时，源自源域的下尾惩罚和跨模块交互作用会降低信任度……
tldr: 提出TrustAgent-RFF预测级可靠性框架，在不改动冻结I/Q分类器且无需目标域标签的条件下，通过融合反事实稳定性、原型一致性、采集域相似度与信号质量等射频证据，并利用源域校准的信任估计器输出预测可信度，从而解决域偏移下射频指纹识别可靠性不足的问题。
en_tdlr: TrustAgent-RFF is a prediction-level reliability framework that, using a frozen I/Q classifier and requiring no target-domain labels, gathers RF evidence (counterfactual stability, prototype consistency, acquisition-domain similarity, and signal quality) and combines it through a source-calibrated trust estimator to deliver trustworthy device predictions under domain shift.
